title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: tighten data residency and key management controls by enforcing RBAC v2 policies that pin KMS keys to regions and surface stronger audit events for key usage. This PR implements KMS region pinning enforcement in the RBAC v2 policy evaluator, adds an audit-logging schema bump (v2) with structured KMS key metadata, provides a data migration / backfill script, introduces a feature-flagged rollout path, and updates docs and CLI migration tooling. Changes were implemented to avoid client-visible API changes: enforcement is gated behind the feature flag 'rbac_v2_kms_residency_enforce' and defaulted to audit-mode in the initial rollout. Migration notes: run the included SQL migration to add the new audit columns and the backfill tool to populate existing records; operators should enable enforcement only after validating backfill. Security considerations: added defensive checks when a principal has no KMS binding to avoid accidental deny loops, added explicit deny logging for policy mismatches, and extended unit/e2e tests for cross-region scenarios. See RELEASE NOTES and docs for rollout steps.

ci_checks: unit-tests: initially failed (nil-case), fixed and pass
merge_details: Squash and merge performed by Priya Singh after approvals. Merge commit message consolidated into 'security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening'.
release_notes: - Enforce KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 (feature-flagged, default audit-only). - Audit logging schema v2: structured KMS metadata and schema_version=2. - CLI migration tool to backfill audit data. Operators must run the migration and backfill before enabling enforcement.
backfill_instructions: 1) Run services/audit/logging/schema/v2/migration.sql against audit DB. 2) Run cmd/cli/migrate_kms_residency --backfill to populate new columns. 3) Validate sample events for schema_version=2. 4) Flip feature flag rbac_v2_kms_residency_enforce to 'enforce' in a canary subset before global rollout.
notes_for_ops: Do not enable enforcement until backfill completes and e2e cross-region tests pass. Monitor 'audit.kms.region_mismatch' and 'rbac.enforcement.denied' metrics for spike. Prepare rollback plan by toggling feature flag to 'audit' and reverting service if needed.
test_plan: Unit tests cover policy evaluator permutations and nil/missing metadata. Integration and e2e tests simulate cross-region key usages and verify audit events and denies. CI pipeline runs full test matrix and security scan. Manual canary planned across two regions for 72 hours.
